The editing flow looks right, including how long content wraps, but I also need to be able to correct the web address itself when editing a bookmark.

- A: Yes, new links should start in “To read.”
- B: Restoring an archived bookmark before changing its status is acceptable.
- C: I also want a clearly separate way to delete a bookmark permanently, ideally with a confirmation so it isn’t confused with archiving.
